user.title: Set up Deadstream
user.description: Stream concerts from archive.org to your media players. After setup, use the Band switches to choose which artists to search.

data_description.collections: Which archive.org collections to include. A switch is created for each selected band so you can toggle them at runtime.
data_description.default_player: Media player to stream to when Deadstream loads. Can be overridden at any time with the Target Player selector.
data_description.play_lossless: Prefer FLAC/SHN over MP3 when available.
data_description.favored_taper: Preferred taper name to rank first in results.
